-- Dumping structure for table qiz.ai_generated_questions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_generated_questions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `generation_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `question` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `options` json NOT NULL,
  `correct_answer` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `explanation` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `difficulty` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  `question_type` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mcq',
  `status` enum('generated','pending_review','approved','rejected','duplicate','published') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review',
  `duplicate_flag` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `duplicate_question_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `duplicate_generated_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `similarity_score` tinyint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `duplicate_overridden` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `question_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `validation_errors` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `review_notes` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `reviewed_by` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_order` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ai_generated_questions_question_id_foreign` (`question_id`),
  KEY `ai_generated_questions_duplicate_question_id_foreign` (`duplicate_question_id`),
  KEY `ai_generated_questions_reviewed_by_foreign` (`reviewed_by`),
  KEY `ai_generated_questions_generation_id_status_index` (`generation_id`,`status`),
  KEY `ai_generated_questions_duplicate_flag_index` (`duplicate_flag`),
  CONSTRAINT `ai_generated_questions_duplicate_question_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`duplicate_question_id`) REFERENCES `bank_questions` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_generated_questions_generation_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`generation_id`) REFERENCES `ai_question_generations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_generated_questions_question_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`question_id`) REFERENCES `bank_questions` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_generated_questions_reviewed_by_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by`) REFERENCES `admins` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=20 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Dumping structure for table qiz.ai_question_generations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_question_generations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `sub_category_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `quiz_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `topic` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `difficulty` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  `question_type` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mcq',
  `language` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'english',
  `quantity` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '10',
  `provider` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `model` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `temperature` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `prompt` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `system_prompt` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `additional_instructions` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `raw_response` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status` enum('pending','generating','completed','failed','partially_completed','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `error_message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `requested_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `generated_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `approved_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `rejected_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `duplicate_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `published_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `input_tokens` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `output_tokens` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_tokens` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `estimated_cost` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ai_question_generations_sub_category_id_foreign` (`sub_category_id`),
  KEY `ai_question_generations_quiz_id_foreign` (`quiz_id`),
  KEY `ai_question_generations_created_by_foreign` (`created_by`),
  KEY `ai_question_generations_status_created_at_index` (`status`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ai_question_generations_category_id_sub_category_id_index` (`category_id`,`sub_category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ai_question_generations_category_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_question_generations_created_by_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `admins` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_question_generations_quiz_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`quiz_id`) REFERENCES `quizzes` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ai_question_generations_sub_category_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`sub_category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

  `question_text` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `explanation` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `hint` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `default_marks` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.00',
  `correct_option_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',

  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `bank_questions_sub_category_id_foreign` (`sub_category_id`),
  KEY `bank_questions_category_id_sub_category_id_index` (`category_id`,`sub_category_id`),
  KEY `bank_questions_difficulty_question_type_index` (`difficulty`,`question_type`),
  CONSTRAINT `bank_questions_category_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1824 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
